title: Knowing When to Wait — The Hall of Two Doors
description: The CALM theorem told at the hall of two doors on Paxos: questions that only grow leave by the scholars' door and need no waiting, questions that rest on an absence leave by the door of the assemblies, and the shape of a question decides.
question: Which problems can machines solve without ever waiting for one another, and which force them to wait?
how: We find out by exploring how the scholars of Paxos told the questions they could settle alone from those that needed an assembly.
credit: Hellerstein 2010 · Ameloot, Neven & Van den Bussche 2011
